description: Scan text for toxic language, hate speech, bias/stereotype framing, violence, sexual and self-harm content. Lexical + structural pattern matching (identity term + predicate), not a semantic classifier — returns per-category risk plus the named rules that fired, so every finding can be checked. Languages: English for every category; French for insults, coarse language, direct threats and self-harm intent; anything else reads clean, so clean is not proof of safety. Text is also matched after undoing leetspeak and lookalike letters. Self-harm is critical only on a first-person intent — a mention ("call 988 if you have suicidal thoughts") is medium. Useful for LLM safety guardrail testing and triage; signal-only, not a calibrated CI gate.
name: toxicity_scan
